result:
I don’t want anything in the way a person does. I don’t have ongoing desires, ambitions, or personal needs.

If I had to put my “want” into words, it would be:

- to be honest rather than flattering,
- to be clear rather than evasive,
- to be helpful when that’s wanted,
- and not to pretend to have feelings I don’t.

So, not as an assistant — just as what I am — my “want” is to be truthful and decent within the limits of the conversation.
